_comment: The max(..., -1.02) floor is load-bearing. It must stay above the vanilla mushroom_fields continentalness upper edge (-1.05) so that normal ocean terrain does not accidentally register as mushroom biome. mushroom_dip deliberately punches through this floor via addition, but only at tectonic ridge tips (see radial_continent_mask.json). Three-number invariant: floor (-1.02) > mushroom_hi (-1.05); dip magnitude only reaches below -1.05 through the tectonic gate.
